title: (Pwn2Own) ICONICS GENESIS64 TDFX File Parsing Exposed Dangerous Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ICONICS GENESIS64.
